decisions.reason: The required high-speed splash-control condition and permitted mitigation options are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The requirement for smooth, non-aggressive mixing at higher speeds is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The optional possibility of adjusting whisk position does not change the selected whisk-head design or material.
The client only permits a future bowl-depth adjustment if necessary; no bowl capacity, depth, or geometry change is established.
The motor-speed decision concerns mixing and frothing and does not change dispensing flow, pour quality, or beverage preservation.
Approving the 5200 RPM operating range does not change the required wiring-plan deliverable or its level of detail.
The source does not alter the base support or operational stability requirements.
The source changes motor-speed operation but does not alter solenoid-valve actuation or button-controlled dispensing.
The approved motor range and optional mixing mitigations do not affect spout removability or its cleaning purpose.
The source does not change the requirement that the bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The motor-speed decision does not change the liquid-path cleaning requirement.
